title: Slavic Migration ABM — replication package
description: Replication package for a model-behaviour study of a Kandler-family demographic agent-based model, motivated by the case of Slavic linguistic expansion in the early-medieval Balkans (c. 600–860 CE) and calibrated against the documented Arabic expansion (c. 630–800 CE). Engine frozen at commit 37054ac; all numbers reproducible at seed 42 with 10 runs per parameter combination on Python 3.13.x on x86-64. Includes the ~156 canonical per-cell run artefacts, the per-sweep durable records, the ODD-protocol model description, the parameter justification table, and the four figures with their generator scripts. Five inherited implementation defects from the original DIA-25063 listing identified and corrected; the audit trail is the paper's methodological contribution.
